The distinction survives there between Kentish women and women of Kent, as a true South-eastern dame will let you know, if it is her fortune to belong to that favoured portion of the county where the great battle was fought, in which the gentler sex performed manful work, but on what luckless heads we hear not; and when garrulous tradition is discreet, the severe historic

arxiv-1411-3334.title: Sparse Quantum Codes from Quantum Circuits
arxiv-1411-3334.creator: Dave Bacon, Steven T. Flammia, Aram W. Harrow, Jonathan Shi
arxiv-1411-3334.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by Dave Bacon, Steven T. Flammia, Aram W. Harrow, Jonathan Shi. We describe a general method for turning quantum circuits into sparse quantum subsystem codes. The idea is to turn each circuit element into a set of low-weight gauge generators that enforce the input-output relations of that circuit element.

arxiv-2011-09474.title: On the interplay between magnetic field and anisotropy in holographic QCD
arxiv-2011-09474.creator: Umut Gürsoy, Matti Järvinen, Govert Nijs, and Juan F. Pedraza
arxiv-2011-09474.description: Abstract We investigate the combined effects of anisotropy and a magnetic field in strongly interacting gauge theories by the gauge/gravity correspondence. Our main motivation is the quark-gluon plasma produced in off-central heavy-ion collisions which exhibits large anisotropy in pressure gradients as well as large external magnetic fields.

arxiv-2105-12371.title: Quotient Space-Based Keyword Retrieval in Sponsored Search
arxiv-2105-12371.creator: Yijiang Lian, Shuang Li, Chaobing Feng, Yanfeng Zhu
arxiv-2105-12371.description: Abstract . Synonymous keyword retrieval has become an important problem for sponsored search ever since major search engines relax the exact match product’s matching requirement to a synonymous level. Since the synonymous relations between queries and keywords are quite scarce, the traditional information retrieval framework is inefficient in this scenario.

arxiv-2201-02467.title: Octahedral tilting in Prussian blue analogues
arxiv-2201-02467.creator: Hanna L. B. Boström* 1,2 & William R. Brant 1
arxiv-2201-02467.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hanna L. B. Boström* 1,2 & William R. Brant 1. Octahedral tilting is key to the structure and functionality of perovskites. Here we show how these distortions manifest in the related Prussian blue analogues (PBAs): cyanide versions of double perovskites with formula A x M[M ′ (CN) 6 ] □ y 1 − y ⋅ n {}_{1-y}\Box_{y}\cdot n H 2 O (A = alkali metal, M and M ′ = transition metals, □ \Box = vacancy/defect).

arxiv-2205-13612.title: On the Role of Quantum Coherence in Thermodynamics
arxiv-2205-13612.creator: Gilad Gour
arxiv-2205-13612.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gilad Gour. We find necessary and sufficient conditions to determine the inter-convertibility of quantum systems under time-translation covariant evolution, and use it to solve several problems in quantum thermodynamics both in the single-shot and asymptotic regimes. It is well known that the resource theory of quantum athermality is not reversible, but in PRL 111, 250404 (2013) it was claimed that the theory becomes reversible “provided a sublinear amount of coherent superposition over energy levels is available”.

arxiv-2211-01173.title: ModMag: A Modular Magnetic Micro-robotic Manipulation Device
arxiv-2211-01173.creator: Max Sokolich, David Rivas, Markos Duey, Daniel Borsykowsky, Sambeeta Das*
arxiv-2211-01173.description: Abstract Electromagnetic systems have been used extensively for the control magnetically actuated objects, such as in microrheology and microrobotics research. Therefore, optimizing the design of such systems is highly desired. Some of the features that are lacking in most current designs are compactness, portability, and versatility.

arxiv-2302-03659.title: Pair Creation of Open Strings between the Unstable-Dressed D p p -branes
arxiv-2302-03659.description: Abstract We study the open string pair production via the interaction of two parallel D p p -branes. The branes have been dressed by the Kalb-Ramond field, a specific U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) gauge potential and a tachyon field of the open string spectrum.

arxiv-2302-13795.title: ChatGPT: A Meta-Analysis after 2.5 Months
arxiv-2302-13795.creator: Christoph Leiter, Ran Zhang, Yanran Chen, Natural Language Learning Group (NLLG)
arxiv-2302-13795.description: Abstract ChatGPT, a chatbot developed by OpenAI, has gained widespread popularity and media attention since its release in November 2022. However, little hard evidence is available regarding its perception in various sources. In this paper, we analyze over 300,000 tweets and more than 150 scientific papers to investigate how ChatGPT is perceived and discussed.

arxiv-2403-14547.title: Estimating Physical Information Consistency of Channel Data Augmentation for Remote Sensing Images
arxiv-2403-14547.description: Abstract The application of data augmentation for deep learning (DL) methods plays an important role in achieving state-of-the-art results in supervised, semi-supervised, and self-supervised image classification. In particular, channel transformations (e.g., solarize, grayscale, brightness adjustments) are integrated into data augmentation pipelines for remote sensing (RS) image classification tasks. However, contradicting beliefs exist about their proper applications to RS images.

arxiv-2404-18052.title: Topological Origin of Floquet Thermalization in Periodically Driven Many-body Systems
arxiv-2404-18052.creator: Hao-Yue Qi, Yue Wu, Wei Zheng
arxiv-2404-18052.description: Abstract Floquet engineering is a powerful manipulation method in modern quantum technology. However, unwanted heating is the main challenge of Floquet engineering, therefore the Floquet thermalization has attracting considerable attentions recently. In this work, we investigate thermalization of periodically driven many-body systems through the lens of Krylov complexity, and find a topological origin of different thermalization behaviors.

arxiv-2411-15181.title: Optimally Controlling a Random Population
arxiv-2411-15181.creator: Hugo Gimbert, Corto Mascle, Patrick Totzke
arxiv-2411-15181.description: Abstract The population control problem is a parameterised problem where a controller sends messages to a whole population of identical finite-state agents, aiming to eventually move them all into a target state. The decision problem asks whether this can be achieved for arbitrarily large finite populations.

arxiv-2501-14333.title: Two almost planetary mass survivors of common envelope evolution 2025 Two almost planetary mass survivors of common envelope evolution – References
arxiv-2501-14333.creator: S. G. Parsons, A. J. Brown, S. L. Casewell, S. P. Littlefair, J. van Roestel, A. Rebassa-Mansergas, R. Murillo-Ojeda, M. A. Hollands, M. Zorotovic, N. Castro Segura, V. S. Dhillon, M. J. Dyer, J. A. Garbutt, M. J. Green, D. Jarvis, M. R. Kennedy, P. Kerry, J. McCormac, J. Munday, I. Pelisoli, E. Pik
arxiv-2501-14333.description: Abstract White dwarfs are often found in close binaries with stellar or even substellar companions. It is generally thought that these compact binaries form via common envelope evolution, triggered by the progenitor of the white dwarf expanding after it evolved off the main-sequence and engulfing its companion.

arxiv-2505-20284.title: Entanglement Cost of Erasure Correction in Quantum MDS Codes Thanks: Corresponding author: Kaushik Senthoor (r.k.senthoor@tudelft.nl)
arxiv-2505-20284.creator: Kaushik Senthoor QuTech, Delft University of Technology, Lorentzweg 1, 2628 CJ Delft, The Netherlands
arxiv-2505-20284.description: Abstract In distributed quantum storage, physical qubits of a code will be stored across the network. When qubits in one of the nodes are lost i.e. when the node is erased, the remaining nodes need to communicate with a new node to replace the lost qubits.

arxiv-2507-07281.title: Almost Sure Convergence for the Last Iterate of Stochastic Gradient Descent Schemes
arxiv-2507-07281.creator: Marcel Hudiani
arxiv-2507-07281.description: Abstract . We study the almost sure convergence rate for the last iterate of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and stochastic heavy ball (SHB) in the parametric setting when the objective function F F is globally convex or non-convex whose gradient is γ \gamma -Hölder.

arxiv-2602-21724.title: Trap-dependent current suppression of optically excited III-V nanowires at cryogenic temperatures
arxiv-2602-21724.creator: Myriam Rihani, Cristina Martinez-Oliver, Markus A. Scherrer, Heinz Schmid, Kirsten E. Moselund, Simone Iadanza
arxiv-2602-21724.description: Abstract \centering0 Abstract The advancement of quantum technology networks necessitates high-speed, low-thermal load, and minimal-noise communication links between cryogenic and room-temperature components. At the heart of modern telecommunication, lay optical interconnects allowing for large data transfer capabilities via optical fibers.

pmc-11479258.title: Zigbee-Based Wireless Sensor Network of MEMS Accelerometers for Pavement Monitoring †
pmc-11479258.creator: Nicky Andre Prabatama, Mai Lan Nguyen, Pierre Hornych, Stefano Mariani, Jean-Marc Laheurte
pmc-11479258.description: In this paper, we propose a wireless sensor network for pavement health monitoring exploiting the Zigbee technology. Accelerometers are adopted to measure local accelerations linked to pavement vibrations, which are then converted into displacements by a signal processing algorithm. Each device consists of an on-board unit buried in the roadway and a roadside unit.

pmc-11728701.title: Pandemic-Proofing: Intercepting Zoonotic Spillover Events
pmc-11728701.creator: Bharti Bhatia, Sudipta Sonar, Seema Khan, Jayanta Bhattacharya, Ricardo Pereira Igreja, Maria Cristina Schneider, Priscila Marques de Macedo
pmc-11728701.description: Zoonotic spillover events pose a significant and growing threat to global health. By focusing on preventing these cross-species transmissions, we can significantly mitigate pandemic risks. This review aims to analyze the mechanisms of zoonotic spillover events, identify key risk factors, and propose evidence-based prevention strategies to reduce future pandemic threats.

pmc-11811546.title: The effectiveness of brain wave synchronization in the theta band on depression and anxiety in opioid-dependent patients
pmc-11811546.creator: Sahar Yari Oskouei, Nastaran Mansouriyeh
pmc-11811546.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Addiction is one of the most common psychiatric disorders and is closely related to depression and anxiety disorders. The presence of these disorders makes the process of addiction treatment difficult. Binaural beats are the representation and perception of a stimulus that does not exist in the outside world but is the brain’s mental perception error of a virtual third sound, that is, the slight frequency difference between the two sounds.

pmc-12452395.title: Newborn Screening—A Worldwide Endeavour to Protect
pmc-12452395.creator: James R Bonham, Dianne Webster, Amy Gaviglio, Aysha Habib Khan, R Rodney Howell, Peter C J I Schielen, Barbara K Burton
pmc-12452395.description: For more than 60 years, newborn (or neonatal) screening has flourished through global collaboration, demonstrating that collective action is key to success. This unity proved to be especially vital during the COVID-19 pandemic, when, despite severe disruptions, NBS services were largely preserved, reflecting the high value placed on early detection and care for vulnerable newborns.

pmc-13129500.title: Comparative Analysis of Gut Microbiomes in Parasitic Roundworms Reveals Phylogeny‐Associated Community Structure and Functional Adaptation
pmc-13129500.creator: Xinyi Fan, Xuan Zhou, Lidan Wang, Xinhui Zhang, Yuanyuan Shen, Yating Xiao, Hui Wang, Lei Deng, Yue Xie
pmc-13129500.description: Roundworm nematodes are globally distributed zoonotic parasites that inhabit the intestinal tract of various mammals. Although these parasites reside in the host’s guts, their own intestinal ecosystems remain poorly understood. Recent evidence suggests that helminths may harbor distinct gut microbiomes that contribute to their physiology and host interactions, yet cross‐species comparisons are lacking.

pmc-13219652.title: Adult RSV Vaccination: What Is the Role of RSV Subgroup in Disease Prevention?
pmc-13219652.creator: S. Elizabeth Williams, Giovanni Checcucci Lisi, Kate Luisi, Kumar Ilangovan, Cassandra Hall-Murray, Kyla Hayford, Elizabeth Begier
pmc-13219652.description: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) cocirculates as two antigenic subgroups, RSV A and RSV B, with irregular dominance by season. Despite highly conserved fusion (F) protein epitopes, sequence, and antigenic differences between A and B, especially within prefusion F, can modulate neutralization and susceptibility.

pmc-13376836.title: Placebo‐Referenced Class‐Level Treatment Effects on Chronic Kidney Disease Progression in Patients With Diabetes: A Network Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13376836.creator: Ravi Kumar Pandey, Maryam Imran, Ishba Manal, Muhammad Ahmad, Aliya Noor, Ali Rohan
pmc-13376836.description: Background and AimMultiple pharmacologic therapies reduce chronic kidney disease (CKD) progression in patients with diabetes; however, the absence of head‐to‐head trials and heterogeneity across studies limits the interpretation of indirect comparisons. We evaluated class‐level treatment effects within a predominantly placebo‐centred evidence network.

pmc-13426223.title: Diagnosis of metastatic prostate cancer by supraclavicular lymph node excision in a patient with persistent macroscopic hematuria: A case report
pmc-13426223.creator: Vladimir Drozda, Zuzana Cierna, Michal Harmanos, Marian Cvik
pmc-13426223.description: A 72-year-old man, who was under regular urological care, was diagnosed with advanced prostate carcinoma, based on a biopsy of a supraclavicular lymph node. Despite rising PSA levels, the patient had negative results on digital rectal examination, negative repeat prostate biopsy, and prostate MRI showed no signs suggestive of malignancy.

pmc-13430260.title: A Descriptive Analysis of Second Amendment Preservation Activities
pmc-13430260.creator: Ugonna P. Okorie, Alexander D. McCourt, Mallory E. O’Brien, Cassandra K. Crifasi
pmc-13430260.description: HIGHLIGHTS•Activities to preserve the Second Amendment have become common across the U.S.•Missouri’s 2021 Second Amendment Preservation Act is a high-profile example.•Over 1,300 local preservation activities have been taken throughout the U.S.•The growth of preservation activities may impede efforts to enforce gun laws. pmc-13466209.title: Anesthesiologists’ Assessment of the Correctness, Completeness, and Coherence of ChatGPT Answers to Patient Preoperative Questions
pmc-13466209.creator: Daniel Werry, Garrett Barry, Vishal Uppal, Jonathan G Bailey
pmc-13466209.description: IntroductionPatients are increasingly turning to large language models (LLMs) for answers. However, LLMs like ChatGPT are relatively new technology and are untested for this purpose. Inconsistency and “hallucinations” are commonly described problems with LLMs. This study tested the consistency, correctness, completeness, and coherence of answers to frequently asked patient questions, as scored by expert anesthesiologists.
